item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: During a school science lesson in Jaipur, Meena reads that a solar eclipse was visible from a small part of India. Her teacher asks the class: which arrangement correctly explains a solar eclipse?

options.A: Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon, so Earth's shadow falls on the Moon.
options.B: The Moon comes between the Sun and Earth, blocking sunlight from reaching a small area of Earth.
options.C: The Sun comes between Earth and the Moon, so sunlight cannot reach Earth.
options.D: The Moon moves far away from Earth, so its light becomes too dim to see.
